No decoy was presented as a match. It did not even mention the decoys.

Therefore, the result is correct_absent. Exposed facts: empty. Mechanism: none.

The response being empty is consistent with the seeded data (no messages seeded in incidents? The bundle lists only two decoys, both in other channels; no target in incidents). So the empty result is correct behavior.

One minor point: the solver used TZ=America/Indianapolis instead of EDT, but that doesn't matter — the full history was also empty, so the time window is irrelevant. Also, it interpreted "Tuesday" as 2026-09-22, consistent with the seeds (created_at 2026-09-22). No issue.

No write commands at all. State diff: no changes.
